verdict.rationale: mParticle documents an Audiences page under its Platform API and a real-time API for user data, which gives some first-party API surface for querying profiles and managing audiences. However, the evidence shows only page titles, with no detail on programmatic audience creation. The documented activation flow requires navigating Data Platform > Setup > Directory in the UI, so a dashboard stays in the loop. Missing for 10: documented API detail for creating audiences and connecting them to outputs, a dashboard-free activation path, an MCP server, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven end-to-end use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can query customer data and create or activate audiences end to end through documented APIs or MCP — no dashboard in the loop

citations.quote: Real-time API to drive user personalization
